description: Core story-in-DM: split story-view.ts rendering by scene content (plain DM text per line for conversation scenes; keep the embed box for map and the book's card grid), deliver the whole prologue in the player's DM via multiple messages, add the StoryState.liveMessageId stale-button model, and add the command-layer ready/resume gate that persists nothing on decline. This is the foundation the other features build on; implement and verify it first.
steps: src/story/types.ts + src/story/engine.ts: add `liveMessageId: string | null` to StoryState (doc: id of the DM message carrying the current scene's live buttons; null in server/ephemeral or before first DM send) and initialize `liveMessageId: null` in freshStory().

src/story/names.ts: add `sanitizeDisplay(input: string): string` — strip to plain chars with the same filter as cleanStem (/[^\p{L}\p{N}\s'’.-]/gu), collapse whitespace, trim, cap ~40 chars, fall back to 'someone' when empty; do NOT drop a trailing 'Eyes'. Document why (display names, not name stems).

src/story/prologue.ts: export a `GATE` object with the EXACT strings from context.json (readyLine, readyYes='Of course', readyNo='Not right now', declineLine, resumeLine, resumeYes="Yes, let's continue", resumeNo='Not right now', inviteResumeLine(inviter)=>`${inviter} reminded me about you. Shall we continue where we left off?`, resumeDeclineLine). Keep the single-stranger second-person voice.

src/discord/story-view.ts: rename the existing renderStory body to `renderRich(screen): StoryMessage` (unchanged embed/map/pack/image behavior; keep StoryScreen). Add `isPlainConversation(view) = !view.map && !view.pack`. Add `renderPlain(screen): StoryMessage[]`: one payload per view.lines ({ content: formatPlain(line), allowedMentions: { parse: [] } }), zero-width space when lines empty, components (input button + choice buttons, SAME custom ids story:<nodeId>:input and story:<nodeId>:c:<i>) ONLY on the last payload, no files. Factor formatPlain from the current formatLine (speaker line = plain text; narration = italic). Add allowedMentions: { parse: [] } to the rich payload too. Export a StoryMessage union type.

src/discord/commands/story.ts: add resolveDm via interaction.user.createDM() wrapped in the dm.ts closed-DM error pattern (catch DiscordAPIError with RESTJSONErrorCodes.CannotSendMessagesToThisUser). Add deliverScene(ctx, user, player, dmChannel): choose renderPlain vs renderRich by isPlainConversation; send plain lines as consecutive dmChannel.send(...) with buttons on the last, or one rich message; capture the final message id into player.story.liveMessageId; save.

src/discord/commands/story.ts execute: keep owner-only restart. Then choose the gate: no player.story -> ready-gate message (readyLine + [readyYes=story:gate:begin][readyNo=story:gate:decline]); else resume gate (resumeLine + [resumeYes=story:gate:resume][resumeNo=story:gate:decline]). Open the DM, send the gate there, reply to the interaction EPHEMERALLY with a pointer ('Check your DMs...'); on closed DMs reply ephemerally with the error. Remove the ephemeral in-place story render for CONTENT; ephemeral stays only on the pointer/acks/owner errors.

src/discord/commands/story.ts component: handle story:gate:begin|resume|decline FIRST (interaction.update({components:[]}) to disable gate buttons, then act; begin/resume re-derive from live player.story so begin-with-progress resumes and resume-without-progress begins; decline persists NOTHING and shows declineLine or resumeDeclineLine). Then scene buttons: no story -> 'Use /story to begin.'; STALE if interaction.message?.id !== player.story.liveMessageId OR player.story.node !== nodeId -> interaction.update({components:[]}) and return WITHOUT applying; else applyAction, interaction.update({components:[]}) to kill the pressed message's buttons, then deliverScene the next scene.

src/discord/commands/story.ts modal: resync on stale (no story or nodeId !== saved node) by delivering the current scene; else apply the text, strip the originating message's components when isFromMessage(), then deliverScene the resulting scene (which may still be ask_name with a notice).

tests/discord-helpers.ts: add a DM channel mock whose send(payload) returns { id } and records payloads; make slashInteraction expose user.createDM() returning that channel; add dmButtonInteraction(userId, customId, messageId) that sets interaction.message = { id: messageId } plus update/reply mocks; add liveMessageId: null to the unlockDaily story literal.

tests/story-flow.test.ts: rewrite the open/click/submitName helpers to read the DM channel's sent payloads (plain content for conversation, embeds for map/book), drive buttons off the live (last) message, and keep all existing branch/name/sanitization/book//daily/images/restart assertions. Add tests: (a) a plain scene sends one message per line, buttons only on last; (b) pressing a non-live/old message strips its components and does NOT advance; (c) a double-click does not repeat a step; (d) map and book render as embeds; (e) /story in a guild opens a DM and replies ephemerally pointing to DMs; (f) closed DMs reply with the error.

tests/story-flow.test.ts (or new tests/story-gate.test.ts): new player /story shows readyLine + two buttons; decline (story:gate:decline) leaves ctx.repo.get(id).story === null and shows declineLine; a second /story re-shows the ready-gate; begin (story:gate:begin) creates the story and delivers the greeting scene; a player WITH progress sees resumeLine and resume lands at the saved node; declining a resume leaves saved progress unchanged.
acceptance_criteria: `node ./node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run tests/story.test.ts tests/story-flow.test.ts` passes all tests (plus tests/story-gate.test.ts if added).
Conversation scenes render as plain DM text (no embed) split one message per line with buttons on the last; map and the book card grid still render as embeds.
An old/non-live button or a double-click never advances or repeats a scene (enforced via liveMessageId and the node==nodeId guard).
Declining the ready-gate leaves player.story === null and nothing persisted; re-invoking /story re-asks.
findings:
DONE. tsc clean; tests/story.test.ts + tests/story-flow.test.ts both pass (49 tests). Full suite: only the 2 documented baseline failures remain (commands.test.ts shop-list; commands-flow.test.ts /profile avatar) — no new regressions.

SIGNATURES (src/discord/story-view.ts):
- export type StoryMessage = { content: string; components?: ActionRowBuilder<ButtonBuilder>[]; files?: AttachmentBuilder[]; allowedMentions: { parse: [] } } | { embeds: EmbedBuilder[]; components?: ActionRowBuilder<ButtonBuilder>[]; files?: AttachmentBuilder[]; allowedMentions: { parse: [] } }
- export function isPlainConversation(view: StoryView): boolean  // = !view.map && !view.pack
- export function renderPlain(screen: StoryScreen): StoryMessage[]  // one payload per view.lines (zero-width space when empty); buttons (input + choices, ids story:<nodeId>:input and story:<nodeId>:c:<i>) only on the LAST payload; always allowedMentions {parse:[]}; never files.
- export function renderRich(screen: StoryScreen): StoryMessage  // former renderStory body (embed + map/pack fields + image). renderStory NO LONGER EXISTS — callers import renderRich/renderPlain/isPlainConversation. StoryScreen interface unchanged.

names.ts: export function sanitizeDisplay(input: string): string  // same char filter as cleanStem (/[^\p{L}\p{N}\s'’.-]/gu), collapse ws, trim, cap 40, fallback 'someone'; keeps a trailing 'Eyes'. Use for /invite inviter display name.

prologue.ts: export const GATE = { readyLine, readyYes:'Of course', readyNo:'Not right now', declineLine, resumeLine, resumeYes:"Yes, let's continue", resumeNo:'Not right now', inviteResumeLine(inviter)=>`${inviter} reminded me about you. Shall we continue where we left off?`, resumeDeclineLine } as const.

GATE custom ids (routed to storyCommand.component via the story: prefix): story:gate:begin, story:gate:resume, story:gate:decline. begin/resume both re-derive begin-vs-resume from live player.story (ensureStory is a no-op when story exists). decline persists NOTHING. story.ts handleGate() disables gate buttons via interaction.update({components:[]}) then acts.

StoryState (src/story/types.ts): added liveMessageId: string | null; freshStory() inits it to null. Stale-button rule in story.ts component/modal: a press is stale if interaction.message?.id !== player.story.liveMessageId OR player.story.node !== nodeId -> interaction.update({components:[]}) and return WITHOUT applying. On a valid press: applyAction, interaction.update({components:[]}) to kill the pressed message, then deliverScene(ctx,user,player,dmChannel) sends the next scene as fresh DM message(s) and sets liveMessageId to the new last message id.

story.ts helpers available for FEAT-002/003 (currently NOT exported — export them if /invite needs reuse): resolveDm(user) -> DmChannel|null (createDM wrapped in CannotSendMessagesToThisUser), deliverScene(ctx,user,player,dm), gateMessage(line,yesLabel,yesId,noLabel), handleGate. The DmChannel shape is { send(payload): Promise<{id}> }.

TEST HELPERS (tests/discord-helpers.ts): dmChannel() -> { send: vi.fn returning {id:'dm-N'}, sent: payload[] }; dmButtonInteraction(userId, customId, messageId, channel?) sets interaction.message={id} + channel + update/reply mocks; slashInteraction(userId, options, ownerId, { dm }) now exposes user.createDM() (pass {dm:null} to simulate closed DMs) and returns .dm; unlockDaily story literal now includes liveMessageId:null. MemoryRepo.all() was NOT added (deferred to the step that adds PlayerRepo.all).
